title: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats

nodes.title: 1. **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)**
nodes.summary: Describes ZX Bank's MFA: biometric login via fingerprint or facial recognition on the ZX Bank Asia app, OTP verification for each transaction sent to the registered mobile/email, and verification steps when logging in from a new device.

nodes.title: 2. **AI-driven Fraud Detection**
nodes.summary: AI systems monitor account activity in real time, flag unusual behavior instantly, and immediately alert customers to any unauthorized or suspicious transaction attempts.

nodes.title: 3. **End-to-End Encryption**
nodes.summary: All communications and financial transactions are secured with industry-standard 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption, and sensitive customer data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.

nodes.title: 4. **Session Timeout & Auto-Logout**
nodes.summary: User sessions automatically expire after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access, and users get prompt warnings before app or online session expiry.

nodes.title: 5. **Secure Fund Transfer Controls**
nodes.summary: Daily and per-transaction limits apply to transfers, especially for new payees or high-risk transactions, and adding new beneficiaries requires additional authentication.

nodes.title: 6. **Regular Security Updates**
nodes.summary: The ZX Bank Asia mobile app receives frequent updates that patch vulnerabilities, and built-in app features detect phishing links and sites, alerting users to threats.

nodes.title: 7. **User Education**
nodes.summary: Regular alerts and campaigns teach customers to recognize safe banking practices and scams, backed by a 24/7 helpline and the in-app AI assistant 'Zia' for security advice.

nodes.title: 8. **Transaction Notifications**
nodes.summary: Customers receive instant alerts via SMS, email, and push notifications for every transaction and every change to account settings.

nodes.title: 9. **Secure Remittance Corridors**
nodes.summary: Cross-border services are offered only with verified financial partners, and select regional remittances additionally use blockchain-based authentication to prevent tampering and improve transparency.
